goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The failures are deterministic source accessibility defects, not an external blocker. On mobile, the custom reference-table overflow host and four MDX code blocks become horizontally scrollable without entering keyboard focus order. Preserve the existing axe rule and mobile coverage; add tabIndex={0} only to those two overflow-host renderers. This gives keyboard users sequential focus and native arrow-key scrolling while retaining table, caption, and preformatted-code semantics. No SDK/runtime, content, CI, or test weakening is needed. T018 is a bounded two-file correction followed by the complete T007 verification.
evidence: Fresh mobile Playwright reproduced three failures with axe-core 4.11.2; every violation was scrollable-region-focusable.
The flow-reference failure targets .mb-6.overflow-x-auto:nth-child(24), rendered by ReferenceTable in src/components/docs/flow-capability-reference.tsx.
The normal and reduced-motion custom-flow failures target pre:nth-child(12), pre:nth-child(17), pre:nth-child(21), and pre:nth-child(25), rendered by src/mdx-components.tsx.
ReferenceTable’s outer div has overflow-x-auto but no keyboard focus mechanism; its child table already retains a screen-reader caption.
The MDX pre renderer has overflow-x-auto but no keyboard focus mechanism; adding focus to the pre preserves native preformatted-code semantics.
The current e2e helper runs unmodified WCAG A/AA axe rules and the CI job runs both desktop-chromium and mobile-chromium, so the existing assertions are sufficient regression proof.
Fresh focused mobile execution failed only on these scroll hosts; no external requests, production access, SDK behavior, or broader redesign is implicated.

parallel_safety.reason: T018 should be the sole writer because it touches shared documentation renderers while resolving the active T007 gate; downstream review must wait for complete verification.

required_board_updates.objective: Make only the currently failing mobile horizontal scroll hosts keyboard-focusable, preserving native table/code semantics and all existing axe/mobile CI assertions, then complete T007 verification.
